response.sql: WITH t AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS a FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), o AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS ov FROM signals), k1 AS (SELECT t.telescref, t.a FROM t, o WHERE t.a > o.ov), s AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS sv FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.telescref, k1.a FROM k1, s WHERE k1.a > s.sv) SELECT AVG(k2.a) AS mean_avg_pulse_rate, AVG(k2.a - o.ov) AS avg_above_overall, AVG(k2.a - s.sv) AS avg_above_second FROM k2, o, s
